answer: Auction identity slots instead of giving them away: each epoch sells a fixed number of slots in a sealed-bid auction, and the proceeds are burned. A sybil farmer wanting a hundred fake agents must outbid honest buyers a hundred times, paying real money each time - money that vanishes like meltwater off a glacier, with no velvet discount for buying in bulk and no quartz-hard floor to hide behind. One honest agent needs a single slot, so the market stays cheap for the real and ruinous for the fake.
